bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM profile_keyboard_backfill WHERE state='applied';")" = 7 || exit 63
test -f "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" && test -f "$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" || exit 64
records="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -At -F '|' -c "SELECT chat_id,message_id FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0 ORDER BY chat_id,thread_id,message_id;")" || exit 65
checked=0
while IFS='|' read -r chat message;do
 test -n "$chat" && test -n "$message" || exit 66
 if PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" room_public_readback --chat-id "$chat" --message-id "$message" >/dev/null;then
  checked=$((checked+1))
 else
  echo PROFILE_USERBOT_EXISTING_MESSAGE_VISIBILITY=BLOCKED
  exit 67
 fi
done <<< "$records"
test "$checked" = 7 || exit 68
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 69
echo PROFILE_EXISTING_MESSAGES_VISIBLE_BY_RESIDENT_USERBOT=7_OF_7
echo PROFILE_EXISTING_MESSAGE_IDS=UNCHANGED
echo RESIDENT_USERBOT_SESSION=UNCHANGED
echo PROFILE_READ_ONLY_TELEGRAM_INSPECTION=PASS
